name: jira-contractor-guest-to-member
description: Capture previous contractor access and preserve permissions when converting a guest user to a member in Azure AD.

actions.name: captureCurrentAccess
actions.description: Snapshot Azure AD groups and application role assignments for the target user before changing the type.

actions.name: restoreAccess
actions.description: Re-apply groups and app role assignments if any were lost during conversion.

actions.name: updateJira
actions.description: Post status and audit notes back to the Jira ticket.

outputs.jiraComment: User type converted and access preservation completed.
